positions.statement: OPB reported that at a July 7, 2026 county policy discussion on data centers, Helm said of data centers, "Well, we can and we should."
positions.excerpt: "Just saying 'data center,' people get up in arms — 'Oh, we can't have those here,'" Helm said during a policy discussion on data centers on July 7. "Well, we can and we should."

verification.note: Quote is on the page (OPB, 2026-07-08, updated 2026-07-15) but is not a current stance: OPB's 2026-08-05 article reports Helm reversed and now seeks a countywide data-center moratorium through the 2027 session, and her voters' pamphlet says she led the effort for a moratorium on large data centers. Presenting the July line alone as her energy stance would mislead. Not fixable without a new source; the Aug 5 OPB article or the pamphlet could be collected next sweep.

verification_summary.balance_notes: Helm: 9 submitted (4 T2, 5 T3), 8 kept, 1 rejected; 13 issues gapped. Smith: 13 submitted, 11 kept; his campaign site and pamphlet statement cover more topics. Both used the same OPB questionnaire. Difference reflects available material, not unequal effort; Helm has a thinner campaign site and her data-center coverage is a news story, which was superseded.
